fusions.name: Breach Leap
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles at the target and bite, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Wing-Clipping Snap
fusions.desc: A quick snap that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Surface Skim
fusions.desc: You skim 4 tiles forward, and your movement speed rises 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Toothpick Plover
fusions.desc: A plover rides with you and fights beside you, pecking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill you make restores 4 health.
